calculation.description: Ranks assets by their trailing 10-trading-day return scaled by the RMS of negative daily returns over the trailing 40 trading days. Higher values indicate recent gains achieved with lower downside risk. All inputs are lagged through the decision date and no future data are used.

validation.regime_notes: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC over the 15 tradable benchmark instruments. 10-day result passed benchmark gates; 5-day IC was 0.01102441 and 20-day IC was -0.02501644, indicating horizon-specific decay and reversal at longer horizons. Calendar IC was mixed: 2026 -0.1133, 2027 0.1262, 2028 0.0476, 2029 -0.0199, 2030 -0.0666, 2031 YTD 0.0421.
